findings.description: The catch hand-rolls the same control-character regex as the private `CONTROL_CHARS` in src/core/merge-gate.service.ts:97. Similar sweeps already exist in brief.service.ts, actions.service.ts, report-data.utils.ts and capability.utils.ts. That is well past the third use, so a shared, exported, newline-preserving scrub in src/core would keep src/cli thin.

The comment cites decision 68 for "pup's own refusals carry remediation steps past the scrubber's 300". Decision 68 sets the scrub-where-it-prints rule and the 300-character cut but doesn't give that rationale. The "not cut to a line" half also repeats what the sanitizeLines JSDoc says. Consider trimming it, and the matching test comment, to the strip-controls reason.
